cause_found.cause: SoundingLine tools/orphan_sweep.ps1 (called at each gear-script startup) taskkills every python tree whose command line matches runners[\/]run_ and whose root pid is not in its lock files; runners\run_v14.py matched. Same mechanism as V13's four silent deaths. Fixed on this side by launching the program as a module (-m runners.run_v14).
